scrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
scrollFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 6
scrollFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
scrollFrame.Parent = mainFrame

local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
grid.Parent = scrollFrame
grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
grid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
local frameWidth = mainFrame.Size.X.Offset
local padding = 10
local columns = 4
local cellWidth = (frameWidth - padding * (columns + 1)) / columns
grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, cellWidth, 0, 40)

grid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
    scrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, grid.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 20)
